title: Add payment tracking fields and enhanced data export

requirements.summary: Update LeadDetailDialog to display and allow editing of payment status with color-coded dropdown
acceptanceCriteria: Payment status appears in the lead detail view
Status can be changed via dropdown in edit mode
Status colors match: Pending (yellow), Paid (green), Failed (red)
Changes persist when dialog is saved

file_operations.description: Add payment status field to the lead detail form with a dropdown selector. Include three options: Pending (yellow badge), Paid (green badge), Failed (red badge). Display the status as a color-coded badge in view mode and as a select dropdown in edit mode. Ensure the payment status is included when calling the updateLead mutation and persists properly. Handle optional payment status gracefully for leads without this field set.

requirements.summary: Update LeadDetailDialog to display and allow editing of notes field as multi-line textarea
acceptanceCriteria: Notes field appears in the lead detail dialog
Textarea allows multiple lines of text entry
Notes persist when dialog is saved
Empty notes display gracefully without errors

file_operations.description: Add a notes field to the lead detail form as a multi-line textarea with at least 4 rows of height. Display notes in view mode as formatted text (preserving line breaks) and as an editable textarea in edit mode. Include the notes field when calling the updateLead mutation. Handle empty or undefined notes gracefully without displaying errors.

requirements.summary: Include payment status and notes fields in all data export formats
acceptanceCriteria: CSV exports include PaymentStatus and Notes columns
Excel exports include PaymentStatus and Notes columns
PDF HTML exports include payment status and notes in lead tables
RTF/DOCX exports include payment status and notes fields
Empty values display as blank cells/fields rather than errors

file_operations.description: Add paymentStatus and notes fields to the LEAD_FIELDS schema. Define a formatter for paymentStatus that converts the variant enum to a readable string (Pending/Paid/Failed) or returns empty string if undefined. Define a formatter for notes that returns the text value or empty string if undefined. Ensure both fields are properly included in the field definitions array.
Ensure the CSV export includes the new paymentStatus and notes columns for leads by using the updated LEAD_FIELDS schema. Verify that empty values are handled gracefully with proper CSV escaping.
Ensure the Excel export includes the new paymentStatus and notes columns for leads by using the updated LEAD_FIELDS schema. Verify that empty values are rendered as blank cells without errors.
Ensure the PDF HTML export includes the new paymentStatus and notes columns in the leads table by using the updated LEAD_FIELDS schema. Verify that empty values display as blank cells in the table.

Ensure the RTF/DOCX export includes the new paymentStatus and notes fields in the leads section by using the updated LEAD_FIELDS schema. Verify that empty values are handled gracefully without displaying errors.

requirements.summary: Update LeadCard to display payment status badge with appropriate color
acceptanceCriteria: Payment status badge appears on lead cards when status is set
Badge colors match the status dropdown (Pending/yellow, Paid/green, Failed/red)
Badge does not appear for leads without payment status
Layout remains clean with both status and payment status visible

file_operations.description: Add a payment status badge to the LeadCard component that displays when lead.paymentStatus is defined. Position the badge prominently alongside the existing status badge. Apply color coding: yellow/amber for Pending, green for Paid, red for Failed. Conditionally render the badge only when paymentStatus exists. Ensure the layout remains clean and visually balanced with both badges visible.

requirements.summary: Add payment status filter to LeadsPage alongside existing filters
acceptanceCriteria: Payment status filter dropdown appears on leads page
Filter includes All/Pending/Paid/Failed options
Filtering updates the displayed leads list
Filter works in combination with existing status and niche filters

file_operations.description: Add a payment status filter dropdown to the LeadsPage alongside the existing status and niche filters. Include options for All, Pending, Paid, and Failed. Add local state to track the selected payment status filter. Update the filtering logic to filter leads based on the selected payment status in combination with existing status and niche filters. Ensure the filter is positioned logically in the filter row and maintains consistent styling with other filter controls.
